title: Mortgage Application — Find the Errors
context: A junior BA at a UK retail bank has drafted a BPMN diagram for the mortgage application process. Unfortunately, it contains several errors that would be flagged in a regulatory audit. The process must follow FCA CONC rules (Consumer Credit) and PRA requirements for responsible lending.
instructions: Review the provided BPMN diagram carefully. Identify and document all errors. There are exactly 4 deliberate problems in the diagram. For each error, state the element ID, the type of issue, and why it is a regulatory concern.

required_elements.description: A boundary error event on the underwriting subprocess is required by regulation

required_patterns.description: At least one audit-relevant task must exist for compliance evidence
All exclusive gateways must have a default path

forbidden_antipatterns.description: No orphaned tasks — the compliance check task must be connected
The eligibility gateway must have a default path

partial_credit_rules.feedback: Credit for identifying at least one issue

feedback_messages.pass: You correctly identified all 4 regulatory errors in the mortgage application process.
feedback_messages.fail: Some errors were missed. Review the diagram for missing boundary events, default paths, orphaned tasks, and audit compliance.
feedback_messages.partial: You found some issues. Check the underwriting subprocess and gateway configurations again.
